${b}0$o 32)"; done; echo "bank$b io/out/dir:$l"; l=""; for o in 80 84 88 8c 90 9
4 98 9c a0 a4 a8 ac b0 b4 b8 bc c0 c4 c8 cc d0 d4 d8 dc e0 e4 e8 ec f0 f4 f8 fc;

l"; done; echo RDY__
